description: This file implements the <first-from-list> element as a class extending MethodOperation for the MiniLang language in the OFBiz framework. It provides functionality to assign the first element of a list to a variable within the environment during method execution.

classes.name: FirstFromList
classes.description: Implements the <first-from-list> element, retrieving the first element of a specified list and assigning it to a designated variable in the environment.

classes.name: FirstFromListFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of FirstFromList based on XML element input.

methods.name: FirstFromList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on XML element attributes, validating the presence and expressions of 'entry' and 'list' attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation to fetch the list from the environment, assigns the first element of the list (or null if empty) to the 'entry' variable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object with its attributes.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate FirstFromList objects from XML elements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation element, 'first-from-list'.
